name: Slipstream
feature_notes: After the passage PIN, a fresh Admiral sign-in on a remembered device asks only for the password. Fleet access still requires active server-verified Admiral authority.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open Admiral My Fleet on your iPad and enter the passage PIN. On a remembered device, a fresh sign-in now asks directly for your Admiral password.
